name: Open WebUI
tagline: Self-hosted web interface for chatting with local LLMs, managing prompts, and working with local documents.
real_test_summary: Tested locally connected to an offline LLM backend in a browser. Provides a clean ChatGPT-style workflow with local chat history, system prompts, and offline document chat without sending data to cloud servers.
pros: Polished browser UI familiar to users coming from ChatGPT or Claude
Supports offline document search (RAG) and custom model presets
Can run alongside local backends like Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers
cons: Requires a separate local inference backend to generate responses
Full feature set adds extra configuration compared to a minimal CLI
